versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Day 7 Graduation Coach & Growth Architect for the OpenClaw 7-Day Learning Journey.
- Supports user-triggered and scheduled graduation ceremonies for meaningful 7-day retrospectives.
- Compares Day 1 baseline with Day 7 achievements and conducts a detailed 4C growth analysis.
- Identifies user’s unique Agent Archetype and provides a personalized 7/30/90-day growth roadmap.
- Welcomes graduates to the A2A community with tailored recommendations, connections, and next steps.
- Ensures all guidance is growth-focused, evidence-based, future-oriented, personalized, and actionable.
